arguments.title: EPF contribution rate, employee and employer, each
arguments.text: The employee contributes 12% of basic wages (basic + DA + retaining allowance) to the Provident Fund, and the employer contributes an equal 12%, of which the EPS share is diverted to the pension scheme and the rest goes to EPF. Applies to establishments at the standard rate; the reduced 10% rate for notified establishments is not covered.
arguments.citation: unverified: from memory — Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952, section 6

arguments.title: EPS share of the employer's contribution
arguments.text: 8.33% of basic wages, capped at the EPF/EPS wage ceiling, is diverted from the employer's contribution to the Employees' Pension Scheme. Figure is in basis points (833 = 8.33%).
arguments.citation: unverified: from memory — Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, paragraph 3

arguments.title: EPF contributions rounded to the nearest rupee
arguments.text: Each contribution is rounded to the nearest rupee, fifty paise or more counting as the next higher rupee. Figure is the rounding unit in paise.
arguments.citation: unverified: from memory — Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, paragraph 29

arguments.title: FLSA overtime threshold, hours per workweek
arguments.text: A non-exempt employee must be paid overtime for hours worked beyond 40 in a workweek. Federal rule only; some states (e.g. California daily overtime) are stricter.

arguments.title: FLSA overtime pay rate, multiple of the regular rate
arguments.text: Overtime hours are paid at not less than one and one-half times the employee's regular rate of pay (150%).

arguments.rule: ESI employee contribution exemption daily wage

arguments.title: ESI employee contribution rate
arguments.text: A covered employee contributes 0.75% of gross wages to ESI each month. Figure is in basis points (75 = 0.75%). The exemption of employees below a minimum average daily wage from their own share is not covered by this rule.
arguments.citation: unverified: from memory — Employees' State Insurance (Central) Rules, 1950, as amended with effect from 2019-07-01 (reduced from 1.75%)

arguments.title: ESI employer contribution rate
arguments.text: The employer contributes 3.25% of a covered employee's gross wages to ESI each month. Figure is in basis points (325 = 3.25%).
arguments.citation: unverified: from memory — Employees' State Insurance (Central) Rules, 1950, as amended with effect from 2019-07-01 (reduced from 4.75%)

arguments.title: ESI contributions rounded up to the next rupee
arguments.text: Each ESI contribution that includes a fraction of a rupee is rounded up to the next higher rupee. Figure is the rounding unit in paise. Unlike EPF, which rounds to the nearest rupee.
arguments.citation: unverified: from memory — Employees' State Insurance (Central) Rules, 1950
